# standards 0.0.13: highlights

The hand-written part of the release notes; scripts/release.py adds the rest.

* **A failed write fails the push**: `--push` exits 1 when a file or target cannot be written, instead of reporting success.
* **Hooks you wrote are kept**: `--install-hooks` no longer replaces an existing `post-commit` or `post-merge` hook it did not write.
* **Plain output off a terminal**: the drift warning is coloured only on a terminal and honours `NO_COLOR`.
